dct_creator_sm: Howard, Steven (University of Wollongong). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1258-3210
dct_description_sm: This dataset contains analysed summary scores for a study on the nature of demonstrated advantage of students identified as gifted in working memory, M-capacity, and executive function. Data were collected from Grade 4 and Grade 8 students in gifted and mainstream educational programs.
dct_title_s: Replication Data for Attentional Processes Subserving Working Memory Study
